pb-r5.unsent: Nothing has been sent. Copy or download this approved text and send it yourself.
pb-r5.watch.title: Monitored data
pb-r5.watch.intro: Choose permitted public pages and the exact values your client needs.
pb-r5.watch.allowed: I checked that these terms allow automated reading.
pb-r5.watch.static: This reads the page as delivered. It does not run page scripts or inspect externally styled visibility.
pb-r5.watch.inspect: Read this page to choose values
pb-r5.watch.failed: The latest read failed. Check the page and choose current values again.
pb-r5.watch.schedule: While the desktop app is open, checks are at most hourly per website. Failures wait longer; changed or ambiguous selectors stop.
pb-r5.watch.chooseHelp: Select only the values your client needs and give each a name.
pb-r5.watch.noCandidates: No unique supported value was found. Use a manual source export instead.
pb-r5.triage.title: IT triage
pb-r5.triage.intro: Review permitted channel messages and prepare an exact summary for a person to handle.
pb-r5.triage.planned: Slack connection awaits commercial permission and installation review. Teams connection is planned. Paste permitted messages and send approved text manually meanwhile.
pb-r5.triage.channelHelp: Copy the channel ID from Slack channel details.
pb-r5.triage.admin: I administer this channel and may use these messages.
pb-r5.triage.importHelp: Paste only permitted source text. This replaces the same message reference and clears earlier summary approval. Held source content is not retained.
pb-r5.triage.messageHelp: Use the original Slack message timestamp, including its decimal point.
pb-r5.triage.quoteHelp: Copy exact excerpts below. No repair, payment or account change is performed.
pb-r5.triage.held: This message is held for a person to inspect. Its private or unsafe text is not retained.
pb-r5.error.REQUEST_FAILED: That action did not finish. Reload the current source and try again.
pb-r5.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The source or client scope changed. Select the current item and review it again.
pb-r5.error.WATCH_SELECTOR_DRIFT: The selected source value changed. Inspect the current page again.
pb-r5.error.WATCH_PRICE_AMBIGUOUS: Choose one exact rupee price without a range or extra figures.
pb-r5.error.WATCH_DESKTOP_REQUIRED: Read monitored pages in the desktop app.
pb-r5.error.SEND_DISABLED: Source reads are off for this workspace.
pb-r5.error.TRIAGE_CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED: Use an exact excerpt from the current message.
pb-r5.notice.changedLine: Selected values changed on the source. Review the measured values and their receipts before sharing.
pb-r5.notice.failedLine: This source could not be checked. Review its permissions and selected values.
